title: Huldah’s Brave True Message
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king had a big question, so
His helpers went to see
A woman, Huldah, wise and brave,
God’s prophetess was she.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father speaks to us
Through prophets, good and true,
So when I listen to their words,
I hear God speaking too.

[Verse 2]
She listened to the Lord, and then
She spoke His message clear,
“The Lord has seen Josiah’s heart,
He’ll bless him, never fear!”

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes and listen well
To those who teach of Him,
For God still speaks in gentle words
As nighttime lights grow dim.

[Chorus]
mood: Listening music. A calm, flowing pulse moves under the voice like helpers walking a quiet road to a wise woman's door, patient and attentive, matching Huldah pausing to hear the Lord before she speaks. The chorus widens gently, clear and unhurried, like a message carried home. By the last verse the flow slows and sinks lower, settling into a soft, listening hush as the lights go dim.
